findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:581 planned_path_authority_bypass: authorization inspects only the incoming verificationIntent. In PLAN, an ordinary main-agent can replace an existing verificationIntent containing plannedPathDeclarations with an otherwise identical intent that omits them; checklist_update succeeds and erases the frozen canonical declaration. Targeted handler probe observed outcome=verificationIntent updated, changed=true, plannedRemaining=false. Guard old and new values under the checklist lock and reject any add/change/removal unless the dispatched verification-intent role owns the write; add an atomic removal mutation test.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed at 92d375b70a: persisted-vs-incoming planned declaration snapshots make ordinary PLAN removal/change/move fail closed; focused smoke proves byte/event atomic removal and file-retarget rejection.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-topology.ts:269 planned_endpoint_role_not_validated: planned source resolution checks only that endpointRef exists, so a topology producer may reference the declaration consumer endpoint while its consumer references the producer endpoint and receive zero diagnostics/result=inconclusive_basis_unverified. This violates verificationIntent ownership of endpoint roles and the promised producer/consumer role-mismatch diagnostic. Validate expected endpoint role at producerRefs/consumerRefs and add a swap mutation bite.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed at 92d375b70a: planned source refs are validated against graph position, so producer/consumer role swaps emit AT_PLANNED_PATH_DECLARATION_DRIFT; mutation control passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-topology.ts:299 topology_totality_is_group_presence_only: diagnostics require non-empty assertion groups but never prove each binding must-priority verificationIntent is referenced, and commandRefs has no required-group check. A targeted report with binding verificationIntentRefs=[INT-MUST], every assertion sourced only from INT-OTHER, and commandRefs=[] returned codes=[] and result=inconclusive_basis_unverified. Implement per-binding must-intent coverage/appropriate-lane totality plus required command-reference diagnostics, with omission mutations.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed at 92d375b70a: topology totality now maps every must intent by lane to positive/mutation assertions and requires non-docs commandRefs; omissions emit AT_INTENT_UNCOVERED or AT_COMMAND_MISSING.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-topology.ts:191-203,258-317 accepts a planned consumer endpoint in producerRefs and a planned producer endpoint in consumerRefs, and treats commandRefs:[] as structurally clean. Repro against current dist returned result=inconclusive_basis_unverified with codes=[] for both mutations. This violates CHK-002 role-mismatch/missing-command structural diagnostics and leaves VI-1995-002-STABLE-INVALID-REFS / VI-1995-002-SEMANTIC-OVERRIDE-MUTATION / VI-1995-004-MUTATION-BITES falsely evidenced; the focused smoke only bites declaration deletion, duplicate ID, orphan producer, and top-level relation/result/basis fields. Add role-aware planned-ref validation, the missing command-group diagnostic, and independent mutations including swapped endpoint roles, unknown declaration/endpoint/canonical refs, orphan consumer, and command omission with restored controls.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed at 92d375b70a: planned endpoint role mismatches, unknown refs and both orphan directions have independent focused mutations with restored controls.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-topology-smoke.ts:141-184 does not prove the promised real verification-intent CLI persistence path. It instantiates handler factories directly and manually sets LATTICE_AGENT, bypassing command-schema parsing, registry dispatch, and the production CLI envelope/role binding. CHK-001 and VI-1995-001-ROUNDTRIP explicitly require round-trip through the real verification-intent CLI flow, while VI-1995-001-WRITER-FREEZE requires every shared-schema persistence surface. Add a temp-repo CLI test using the registered verification-intent dispatch/role environment for the eligible PLAN checklist_update, plus CLI-level unauthorized story_create/checklist_add/checklist_update and post-PLAN bites, asserting bytes/events remain unchanged on rejection.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed at 92d375b70a: temp-repo real CLI tests prove registered verification-intent PLAN success plus unauthorized checklist_update/checklist_add/story_create and post-PLAN rejection with atomic bytes/events.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-topology-smoke.ts:240-269 only compares canSendStoryEventWithoutSnapshotCan(..., PLAN, START, ...) before/after topology changes. VI-1995-004-LIFECYCLE-EQUIVALENCE requires both PLAN→DEV and DEV→REVIEW outcomes for otherwise identical valid, missing, and invalid topology Stories, and VI-1995-004-LEGACY-TRANSITION-MUTATION claims the same lifecycle facts stay constant. The current evidence note overstates this coverage. Add explicit transition comparisons for both boundaries and each topology state, while also asserting phase/process events remain unchanged; keep the no machine.ts/phase-gates diff source inventory as an independent assertion.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed at 92d375b70a: table-driven valid, missing and malformed topology cases prove equal PLAN-to-DEV and DEV-to-REVIEW decisions, unchanged phase and no new events.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-topology-smoke.ts:135-140,165-177 does not cover the full must matrix recorded for VI-1995-001-INVALID-SHAPE and VI-1995-001-SEMANTIC-TAMPER. It tests only an unknown version, one duplicate endpoint, and one expectedFileRef mismatch; it does not bite empty/duplicate declaration IDs, zero consumers, producer/consumer role errors, unsupported artifact kind, malformed/wrong-item/unsafe/unresolved fileDeclarationRef, or stable-ID mutations of relation/role/symbol/outputFactRef. The implementation may reject many through Zod, but the current evidence cannot substantiate the item-level claims or atomicity. Add table-driven schema plus real persistence bites for every enumerated class, with pre/post bytes unchanged and clean control restoration.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed at 92d375b70a: focused schema/semantic matrix covers version, IDs, roles, consumers, artifact kinds, file refs, stable-ID symbol/output drift, unknown/orphan/duplicate refs and atomic rejection.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:581-586 only authorizes based on declarations present in the incoming verificationIntent, so an ordinary PLAN caller can erase an already verification-intent-owned plannedPathDeclarations array by resubmitting the same intent without that field. Production-handler repro on current build persisted before=1, after=0 and returned `Checklist CHK-001: verificationIntent updated`; docs/CLI.md promises ordinary callers are rejected and CHK-001 requires unchanged declaration bytes. Add a reverse guard comparing existing versus proposed planned declarations (and their ChecklistItem.files bindings), reject non-dispatched mutation/removal atomically, and add the deletion/file-retarget mutation bite.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed at 92d375b70a: authorization compares persisted and incoming declaration snapshots, preventing ordinary callers from erasing frozen PLAN declarations even when incoming payload contains none.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-topology.ts:191-202 resolves a planned endpoint by ID existence only; producerRefs and consumerRefs call the same validator at lines 269-298 without an expected role. On the current production build, swapping producerRefs to declaration consumer EP-C and consumerRefs to producer EP-P returned result=inconclusive_basis_unverified with diagnostics=[] instead of warning/drift. This lets topology invert the verificationIntent-owned direction while appearing structurally coherent, contrary to CHK-002 role-mismatch totality and the docs/CLI.md no-endpoint-role-override promise. Validate planned endpoint role against graph position and add an independent swapped-role mutation bite.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed at 92d375b70a: graph source positions enforce canonical planned endpoint roles and role-swap mutations now deterministically bite with AT_PLANNED_PATH_DECLARATION_DRIFT.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-topology-smoke.ts:212-214 and the process-fact contract only prove that acceptance_matrix is registered L0; they never perform VI-1995-003-NON-EVIDENTIARY’s required attempt to feed the renderer/result back as verification evidence. Current gate consumption in packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:768-777 accepts any non-deferred verificationEvidence row with result=pass without checking command/fact authority, so an acceptance_matrix manual transcript can presently cover a bound intent despite the claimed non-evidentiary guarantee. Add a production-path negative test and a mechanical rejection/non-covering rule for acceptance_matrix-derived evidence; L0 registry labeling alone is not a gate boundary.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed at 92d375b70a: checklist_update, verification_evidence_add and batch reject acceptance_matrix-derived evidence atomically; general verification and ProofStory completeness ignore legacy/injected rows; real CLI tests and process-fact contract pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-topology.ts:94 acceptance_matrix_evidence_classifier_is_bypassable_and_overbroad: F-010 was closed with prose regexes rather than a typed source/provenance fact. A manual_transcript pass whose note is `Observed matrix projection was inconclusive_basis_unverified.` is classified false and buildVerificationCoverage reports status=covered, so feeding the matrix computed result label back still satisfies the general gate path. Conversely an unrelated legitimate note `Result: warning threshold test passed with expected fallback.` is classified true and rejected. Replace the content heuristic with an explicit normalized evidence-source/authority discriminator (or at minimum exhaustively reject the reserved result tokens without generic Result:warning false positives), apply it consistently at writer and legacy consumers, and add both bypass and false-positive controls.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed across cef7fc56fe and 35de890d50: shared typed producer-command provenance rejects exact acceptance_matrix commands for every evidence kind; bounded legacy output fallback applies only to manual_transcript, catches paraphrased reserved results, preserves exact legacy compatibility, and does not misclassify unrelated warning prose or legitimate logic/integration notes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/milestone-status.ts:198-209,473-540 remains an unpatched verificationEvidence consumer after the F-010 fix. Current-dist repro replaced M1’s two required evidence rows with passing commands `lattice acceptance_matrix --storyId=B-1995`; buildMilestoneStatusReport returned `ledger=planned; checklist=complete; evidence=covered; requiredEvidence=covered` and both intent subobjectives `status=covered`. Writer rejection plus filters in verification.ts/proofstory.ts do not fail closed for legacy/injected evidence in milestone_status/closeout. Apply the same non-evidentiary predicate in milestone evidence status/coverage and add a milestone-status (and derived closeout if applicable) negative mutation asserting matrix-derived rows are not covering.
